summary: The exact frozen candidate gives a self-contained finite rational counterexample to the sharp Gamma_d/2^n assertion at d=23,n=3*10^92. The frozen proof is self-contained and has no predecessor dependencies. It does not invoke the earlier completion theorem, a hitting-model equivalence, any mixed-integer centerpoint inequality, or ordinary Grunbaum lower depth. No approximation, weak convergence, smoothing, or limiting body is used. n and the number of generating simplices are enormous but finite. Exposed-fiber isolation chooses a finite tilt by a maximum over finitely many bounded quantities. The uniform depth upper bound applies pointwise and hence to the supremum, so no attainment theorem or exchange of infimum and limit is needed.
